definitions.explanation: Moving or still images, especially in professional or broadcast contexts.

notes:
COMPOUND: {映|えい} (reflect, project) + {像|ぞう} (image)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {映像|えいぞう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to watch footage)
- {映像|えいぞう}⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧ (video work, visual production)
- {映像|えいぞう}⟦{制作|せいさく}→制作：04320_seisaku⟧ (video production)
- {映像|えいぞう}⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧ (video technology)
- {映像|えいぞう}⟦{編集|へんしゅう}→編集：04439_henshuu⟧ (video editing)
- ⟦{生|なま}→生：03509_nama⟧{映像|えいぞう} (live footage)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {映像|えいぞう} - formal, professional contexts (TV, film)
- ⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧ - casual, online videos
- ⟦ビデオ→ビデオ：01499_bideo⟧ - often refers to physical media
